peak_days: Weekends (Saturday & Sunday): Moderate to heavy crowds, peaking at 2,000 to 4,000+ daily visitors. Large day-tripper crowds travel from Warangal and Hyderabad.
festival_crowds: Festivals (Shivaratri & Heritage Day): High-density crowds pack the complex. Expect slight delays for inner sanctum access and security screening.
tips: The best time to visit Ramappa Temple is during the winter months (from October to March) when the weather is cooler and more pleasant for sightseeing. The monsoon season can make the area lush and green, but heavy rains may cause occasional disruption
Weekdays (Monday to Friday): Very minimal and peaceful crowds. Daily visitors average between 500 to 1,500 people, making it ideal for peaceful sightseeing.
